integrity: Standalone standard-library checker compares exact rational Gram entries, determinants, sector actions and full rank at dimensions three through eight; the unbounded theorem is proven analytically in the accompanying result.
scientific_limitations: Uniform measure on nonzero rank-one symmetric binary matrices, dimension at least three, constant plus all independent diagonal and offdiagonal coordinate additive characters. Claims concern this selected nonorthogonal Fourier band, not arbitrary frequencies or fields. The 2010 related publication has only a year/month evidenced here; 2014-10-27 is the earliest verified day-resolved public posting among the stated dated anchors, not a claim that no older related publication exists. External originality priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Sharp coordinate-Fourier spectrum of the punctured binary Veronese cone
